name: fanuc-python
description: Write Python code for Fanuc robots with the UnderAutomation Fanuc SDK.

interface.longDescription:
UnderAutomation Fanuc SDK for Python (pip UnderAutomation.Fanuc, import underautomation.fanuc). Use it when Python code talks to a Fanuc robot controller (R-30iA, R-30iB, R-30iB Plus, R-50iA) or a ROBOGUIDE virtual robot, or when the user asks about the Fanuc SDK, its protocols or its exceptions. Protocols of the SDK: CGTP web server, SNPX (Robot Interface), Telnet KCL, FTP, RMI (option R912) and Stream Motion (option J519). It answers questions such as which protocol and which controller option to use, how to read and write registers, variables and I/O, how to run a TP program, read the position or the alarms, transfer files, move the robot, plan a trajectory, compute the kinematics offline, and why an exception is thrown. It holds the documentation pages, the Python code samples and the list of every public class and member of the package, with the Python names.

Intended users: developers who write Python applications that connect a PC to a Fanuc robot controller with the UnderAutomation Fanuc SDK.

Limitations: the skill is documentation only. It does not connect to the robot and does not run code by itself. It documents version 7.1.0 of the SDK. The SDK (pip UnderAutomation.Fanuc) must be installed in the project and has its own license agreement.
capabilities: Choose the protocol and the controller option for a task
Write Python code with the public API of the Fanuc SDK 7.1.0
Explain the exceptions of the SDK and what to check
Apply safety rules to the code that moves a robot
defaultPrompt: Which protocol should I use to read the position registers of my Fanuc robot?
Write a program that reads R[1] to R[10] and prints them.
Why do I get an exception when I connect to my Fanuc controller?
